definitions.explanation: The morning of the current day.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I woke up early this morning.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べましたか→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: What did you eat this morning?

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The weather was good this morning.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The train was crowded this morning.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧、⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒に：25645_isshoni⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I ran into a friend at the station this morning, and we went to school together.

notes:
{今朝|けさ} means this morning. Note the irregular reading.

READING:
Read as けさ (NOT こんあさ or いまあさ). This is a special compound reading.

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧: today
- ⟦{今晩|こんばん}→今晩：02882_konban⟧: tonight
- ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧: tonight
- ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧: yesterday
- ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧: tomorrow

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今朝|けさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧: this morning's newspaper
- {今朝|けさ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since this morning
- {今朝|けさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: I woke up early this morning

SIMILAR IRREGULAR READINGS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧: today (not こんにち)
- ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧: yesterday (not さくじつ)
